arms: Same semantic content with compact envelope
experiment_candidates.confound: Prompt-prefix/caching effects and repeated rereads may erase billed cost benefit.
experiment_candidates.hypothesis: Lossless compact tool/file envelopes reduce repeated input processing without changing task-visible evidence.
experiment_candidates.negative: Exact original evidence must be recoverable; omissions or displaced action instructions veto.

arms: Summary with deterministic pointers to full retained raw artifacts
experiment_candidates.confound: Include summary generation, recovery reads, coordinator and all subagent/provider tokens.
experiment_candidates.hypothesis: Prospectively triggered summaries reduce repeated history ingestion while preserving failure evidence.
experiment_candidates.negative: Seed a previously observed unresolved failure and require its recovery; never silently erase an error or verification debt.

experiment_candidates.confound: Hold task families/repositories out of memory building; repeated-task leakage invalidates savings.
experiment_candidates.hypothesis: Correctly retrieved prior solved experience improves next related task while reducing total cost.
experiment_candidates.negative: Separate unrelated and misleading-memory cohorts; no gold patch, hidden tests or evaluated-task outcomes in retrieval pool.

experiment_candidates.confound: Balance cold/warm/order/session-age; require provider cached/uncached token fields and prices.
experiment_candidates.hypothesis: Stable context prefixes reduce billed uncached input cost even if total token count is unchanged.
experiment_candidates.negative: Same exact model/tools/task context; do not assert provider cache behavior from local prefix hashes alone.

required_for_any_economy_claim: Prospective fixed independent task sampling and arm randomization; preserve all failed/timeout/capture-invalid attempts in denominator.
Externally graded task behavior and failure-type coverage; quality noninferiority/evidence thresholds preregistered.
Complete provider request telemetry across primary agent, subagents, retries, compaction, verification and grading; cached/uncached input/output/reasoning separately if available.
Compare total billed cost plus token/request/latency metrics; missing billing fields remain unresolved.
Artifact byte pins and reproduction commands for exact declared runtime; causal/OS/source authentication claims require their own evidence.
scope: These are prospective separate experiment candidates. They do not change or reroll the existing48-pair development series or192-pair independent confirmation.
